effect.name: Slit Scan
effect.description:
Slit Scan filter with Scan and Stargate modes.
Every frame contributes only the pixels under a thin slit, and the slits of consecutive frames are laid side by side, so one axis of the image becomes time.
effect.author: phoebus-84

parameter.name: Position
parameter.comment:
Position of the slit across
the input. 0=left/top, 1=right/bottom

parameter.name: Vertical
parameter.comment: Sample a column instead of a row

parameter.name: Width
parameter.comment:
Slit width, 1-64 px: how far
the image advances per frame

parameter.name: Reverse
parameter.comment:
Scan: new slits enter at the
left/top edge; Stargate: slits flow inwards

parameter.name: Depth
parameter.comment:
Stargate: how far the tunnel
reaches (size of the dark hole in the middle)

parameter.name: Fade
parameter.comment:
Stargate: darken the walls with
distance, as in a long exposure.
